# Historical full-sequence inference regression inputs

These exact v10 browser downloads were the verified inputs to the local v11
worker and UI checks. The checkpoint has 30,400 TD updates; this is a historical
fixture, separate from the later 31,000-update recorded Run B. The comparison
retains the exact Initial (11 cuts) and trained (24 cuts) rollout episodes.

Source: `random-training-v10/ui/browser/` in the retained Module 3 audit.
The fixture hashes are pinned in `manifest.json`. No manufacturing qualification.
